tasks.label: SystemView: Durdur
tasks.detail: SystemView koprusunu kapatir, ST-Link'i debug/flash icin serbest birakir
args: $p = Get-CimInstance Win32_Process -Filter "Name='python.exe'" | Where-Object { $_.CommandLine -match 'sysview_stlink' }; if ($p) { $p | ForEach-Object { Stop-Process -Id $_.ProcessId -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue }; Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 500; Write-Host 'SystemView koprusu kapatildi, ST-Link serbest.' } else { Write-Host 'Kopru zaten kapali.' }

tasks.label: SystemView: Baslat
tasks.detail: SystemView IP Recorder icin 127.0.0.1:19111 (debug oturumu kapali olmali)
